about: The device library: native slides lifted from the references, sanitised (identity stripped, every word replaced, colours mapped to theme roles, type floored at 8pt) and fitted to the house rules. Place one with deckkit.devices.place and fill every slot; a sample left behind fails P19.

DL01.name: Decision cards over dated rail
DL01.mechanism: Four numbered decision cards chained by chevrons name what the audience must commit to, and a dated milestone rail beneath shows what each commitment delivers and when.

DL02.name: Staged mechanism with brief rail
DL02.mechanism: An iconned challenge strip states the pain, a numbered three-stage band traces the mechanism with its rule passes and a dashed failure loop back to the exceptions queue, a value strip names what it buys, and a brief rail closes on the decision it supports.

DL04.mechanism: Four forum columns ordered from strategic to operational each show a month calendar of meeting days whose fill density reads as cadence, with chair, members and decision rights in matching rows, while a numbered escalation ladder beside them times each handoff by working day.

DL05.name: Chevron stages with current-stage panel
DL05.mechanism: A six-stage chevron pipeline gives each stage a glyph, an action and an output, marks the current stage, and a panel below opens that stage into its gate criteria, owners and open risks.

DL06.name: Foundation, waves and site fan-out
DL06.mechanism: A shared foundation built once feeds four dated wave headers that each fan out to the sites they take live, a numbered readiness checklist sets the bar every site must clear, and a four-step band with an exit gate shows the anatomy every wave repeats.

DL07.name: Gated pipeline over stage cards
DL07.mechanism: A gated pipeline strip runs input through two control gates and a grouped three-stage core to an output, four aligned stage cards beneath it unpack each segment with the widest carrying a numbered sub-flow, and a controls rail shows what runs under every step.

DL08.name: Agent mesh under domain tabs
DL08.mechanism: Domain tabs divide a mesh of linked agent discs into columns, a tinted wedge spotlights the starting domain inside the full landscape, a status key decodes live, planned and shared agents, and a platform panel underneath shows the services every domain draws on.

DL09.name: S-curve with operating vignettes
DL09.mechanism: Value rises along an S-curve across four horizons while small vignettes above it show human steps giving way to agent steps, so the climb and the operating change that drives it read together.

DL10.name: Four-stage record trace with hub
DL10.mechanism: One named record moves through four numbered stage columns, fields in, lines matched in a table with the exception row marked, the exception checked against five sources around a hub, outcomes logged, while a strip beneath sets the manual path against the traced one.

DL11.name: Phase lane gantt with gated milestones
DL11.mechanism: A quarter and month grid carries two phase bars, a milestone axis drops each named gate or checkpoint to its date, and a per-quarter target row closes on the final count, so duration, gates and outcome read down the same columns.
samples: Every region runs the new planning process within five quarters

DL12.name: Role hub, workflow and escalation
DL12.mechanism: Three panels read left to right, from who holds which role around a central office, through the gated stages that roll up into forums with their cadence, to the severity ladder that routes an issue to the forum that decides it and how fast.

DL13.name: Dated gantt with gates and phases
DL13.mechanism: Staggered phase bars on a dated axis close on exit rings, and dashed gate lines drop through matching phase cards to the decision boxes that hold the end date.

DL14.name: Channel mesh to agent hub
DL14.mechanism: The same four roles are drawn twice, first wired to every channel in a crossed many-to-many mesh and then wired through named agents around one hub, with a solid wedge between them carrying the shift.

DL15.name: Step network handed to agents
DL15.mechanism: A tonal chevron ramp sets four horizons, a team band shrinks beneath it, and the same process-step network repeats under each horizon with person-run nodes turning into agent-run nodes, so the handover reads by colour count while a tools tray and an outcome strip state what each horizon adds.

DL16.name: Principle columns with proof diagrams
DL16.mechanism: Each of three peer columns states a principle as a heading, proves it with its own mini diagram, and closes on two short reason cards, so every claim sits above its evidence.

DL17.name: Disc-crowned figure band, card row
DL17.mechanism: Six glyph discs break the top edge of a dark band so each headline figure reads as one measured column, and a row of implication cards closes on a solid panel that turns the figures into the next step.

DL18.mechanism: Two input signals feed five ordered lanes, each lane names its owner and the one rule that sends a case there, with shared controls and an escalation clock beneath.

DL19.mechanism: Five numbered stage columns carry one population left to right, a funnel showing how far it narrows and a three-way route showing where each case goes, so the dark closing panel's result reads as the sum of visible steps.

DL20.mechanism: Seven levels step down an indented ladder whose fills mark the status of each rung, a keyed rail names what each fill means and places the audience on the ladder, and three cards state what moving to the next rung takes.

DL21.mechanism: A band of grouped source systems sits over a captioned seam that names what crosses down and back up, a platform layer turns those sources into outcomes through four chevron-joined stage cards of component chips, and a full-width strip of enablers beneath reads as touching every layer.

DL23.mechanism: A dated rail of gated phase milestones runs into a target, each phase column proves its outcome with its own mini-device, a duration and a checked deliverables list, and a brace hands the last two phases to a continuous improvement loop.

DL24.name: Nested platform hub with feeders
DL24.mechanism: Six source cards each send an arrow into a nested hub whose rings name the shared foundation and rules and whose core numbers the platform's services, and an arrow from the hub lands on each of five outcome cards, so every result traces back through one shared platform to its sources.

DL25.name: Pill-headed input, method, output triptych
DL25.mechanism: Three pill-headed panels read left to right through handoff discs, the widest holding six numbered step cards marked by who runs each one beside proof zones, so the method is the subject while the inputs and typed outputs frame it and two strips beneath name what the method reuses and where else it applies.

DL26.name: Staged rule lanes to a decision
DL26.mechanism: Inputs feed yes-or-no checks, ordered rules route each case to one of two outcomes, and a logged record with one routed sample proves the path.

DL27.name: Value-effort field with wave key
DL27.mechanism: Numbered candidates sit on a value by effort field split into four named quadrants, their marks encode delivery wave, and a key rail decodes every number so the room reads which go first and why.
samples: Three quick wins start next quarter while four bets wait for the platform

DL28.name: Winding road with growing horizon cards
DL28.mechanism: A road winds through one pin per year, and each year's card grows in team size, business areas served and live use cases, so the climb reads from the cards swelling along the route to a destination callout.
samples: One AI team scales from a pilot to every area

DL29.name: Half-wheel over layered base
DL29.mechanism: Five equal sectors fan out from one core so every team reads as a peer consumer, while two tabbed layer cards and two deep platforms beneath show what the core is built on and fed by.
samples: One governed data core now serves all five planning teams

DL30.name: Lanes into a store ring, mosaic readout
DL30.mechanism: Grouped sources feed three ingestion lanes that each converge on one ring holding shared stores wired to a core, and a mosaic on the ring's far side breaks the served value into domains and their use cases, so every use case has a visible path back to one governed copy.
samples: Sources land once in one governed platform that serves ten use cases

DL31.name: Bounded platform core with side columns
DL31.mechanism: Sources stand in a column outside the left edge and consumers outside the right, while one bounded core holds an access band, pipeline lanes and an agent runtime above a shared platform band, so every crossing of the boundary reads as a decision.
samples: One governed platform serves every agent from shared, certified data
